notes.zh-CN: 手机与电脑会话改用 WebSocket 实时同步，支持从手机在已有项目中新建会话；设置页按 Agent 分组。Antigravity 后台唤醒结果自动并入原回合，并修复回收期间追问造成的结果错位。macOS 为 universal 包；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名，沿用上版签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。自托管手机同步服务需同步更新，并透传 WebSocket Upgrade。
notes.en: Phone and desktop conversations now sync in real time over WebSocket, and phones can create a session in an existing project. Settings are grouped by agent. Antigravity background wakeup results are merged into their original turn, including when a follow-up is sent during replay. macOS is universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed with the previous release identity; the IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only. Self-hosted mobile sync services must be updated and forward WebSocket Upgrade headers.
